data.name: Lulua
data.gender_notes: Lulua is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Lulua means 'gentle flow' or 'smoothness'. It is a name derived from the root word 'l-l-w' which signifies 'flow' or 'movement'. In Islamic culture, this name symbolizes the gentle and continuous flow of God's mercy and blessings in one's life. The name Lulua carries the meaning “Gentle flow” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lulua usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle flow and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Lulua belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle flow.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lulua total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
